'''Robert Fletcher I S Beatdown ala peach''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Robert Fletcher]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-16292">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16292 I   S   Beatdown  ala  peach], DeckTech (Robert "Peachykeen" Fletcher, 29 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16292/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16292/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Robert Fletcher]]
* '''Published:''' 29 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''I   S   Beatdown  ala  peach''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 ISB Fletcher DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' my fun isb deck  has went 10-1 in tournament play...although it's going to be retired now that tatooine is coming out...please provide advice as to how i can adapt to the changing meta...thanks

== Original post ==

'''I   S   Beatdown  ala  peach'''
* '''Author:''' Robert "Peachykeen" Fletcher
* '''Published:''' May 29, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' my fun isb deck  has went 10-1 in tournament play...although it's going to be retired now that tatooine is coming out...please provide advice as to how i can adapt to the changing meta...thanks

=== Strategy ===

this deck was very successful - but is raped by many cards in tatooine.  mobilization points is necessary to the deck, and "Don't Do That Again" wrecks this, as well as the Republic characters (which can deploy to the spaceport docking bay i place at Coruscant regardless of whether i have a star destroyer at the system or not).  i enjoy playing isb and would appriciate any input that may help me adapt to the post-tattoine meta game.  when rating this deck, please rate it as a B.T. deck (before tatooine) and again i appriciate any input

pk - /esn
